description.value:
Trigger You Hot Load a firearm.

Requirement You are wielding a second loaded firearm.

Whatever you did to the right hand, the left one already knows.

Your next Strike this turn with the other firearm also gains one additional damage die, without spending a second Hot Load use and without any Gun Failure risk of its own. If the Hot Loaded weapon suffers Gun Failure, this benefit is lost before it applies.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Hot Load dependency). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
